+import re
+from pathlib import Path
+
+# Pattern matches shebangs with various python interpreters
+# Matches patterns like: #!/usr/bin/env python3, #!/usr/bin/python3.11, etc.
+# Also handles pythonw, pypy, and pythonw-* variants  
+shebang_pattern = re.compile(r'^#!.*\b(python|pypy)(?:w)?[0-9.]*([ \t].*)?$')
+
+def _replace_shebang(match: re.Match[str]) -> str:
+    """Replace matched shebang with #!python preserving any arguments."""
+    groups = match.groups()
+    if groups and groups[1]:  # group 1 is the python/pypy(w)? part, group 2 is args
+        return f"#!python{groups[1]}"
+    return "#!python"
+
+def process_script_dir(scripts_dir: Path) -> None:
+    """Process all scripts in the given directory, replacing shebangs."""
+    if not scripts_dir.is_dir():
+        return
+        
+    for script_path in scripts_dir.iterdir():
+        if not script_path.is_file():
+            continue
+            
+        try:
+            content = script_path.read_text(encoding='utf-8', errors='ignore')
+        except (OSError, UnicodeDecodeError):
+            # Skip binary files or unreadable files
+            continue
+            
+        if not content:
+            continue
+            
+        lines = content.splitlines(keepends=True)
+        if not lines:
+            continue
+            
+        # Check if first line matches our shebang pattern
+        first_line = lines[0].rstrip('\n\r')
+        match = shebang_pattern.match(first_line)
+        
+        if match:
+            # Replace the shebang while preserving line ending
+            lines[0] = _replace_shebang(match) + '\n'
+            # Write back the modified content
+            try:
+                script_path.write_text(''.join(lines), encoding='utf-8')
+            except OSError:
+                # If we can't write, skip this file
+                continue
